# Syncall

> AI voice agents for customer calls in Uzbek and Russian, with call analytics and chatbots for business teams. Speech-to-text and text-to-speech tools are available in Syncall Studio.

## Product pages

- [Homepage](https://www.syncallai.com/): voice agents, call recordings, workflows, setup, and pilot requests
- [Markdown overview](https://www.syncallai.com/index.md): a text overview of the product
- [Call analytics](https://www.syncallai.com/analytics): call quality review and an illustrative scorecard
- [Chatbots](https://www.syncallai.com/chatbots): customer messaging using a business knowledge base
- [Speech-to-text Studio](https://www.syncallai.com/cabinet/stt): sign in to transcribe audio
- [Text-to-speech Studio](https://www.syncallai.com/cabinet/tts): sign in to create speech

## Learn more

- [Use cases](https://www.syncallai.com/use-cases): banking, payment reminders, appointments, surveys, and lead qualification
- [Features](https://www.syncallai.com/features): language handling, integrations, and deployment options
- [Integrations](https://www.syncallai.com/integrations): telephony and CRM scope
- [Pricing](https://www.syncallai.com/pricing): usage, setup, and pilot terms
- [Customer examples](https://www.syncallai.com/case-studies): call recordings and available customer stories
- [About](https://www.syncallai.com/about)
- [Sitemap](https://www.syncallai.com/sitemap.xml)

Public marketing pages have Russian (/ru) and Uzbek (/uz) variants. English is served at the root. Studio requires sign-in. Legacy /stt and /tts URLs redirect to the corresponding Studio tools.
